summary: A ductile iron follower gland used in standard mechanical joint assemblies to compress the rubber gasket against the pipe spigot and bell socket, creating a watertight, flexible seal. The E-type gland profile ensures even gasket compression around the full pipe circumference. Widely used in water distribution, sewage and industrial pipeline networks where ease of field assembly is a priority.

name: Retainer Ring (Dn-100 To Dn 900,pn10 /16)
summary: A ductile iron retainer ring is a locking component used in restrained mechanical joint assemblies to grip the pipe spigot and prevent axial pullout under internal pressure, water hammer or ground movement. Installed between the pipe and the gland, the retainer ring’s serrated or toothed inner edge bites into the pipe wall when tension is applied, providing a positive mechanical lock that eliminates the need for concrete thrust blocks at bends, tees, reducers and end caps.
features: Prevents axial pipe pullout under internal pressure, water hammer and ground movement
Serrated or toothed inner edge grips pipe spigot for positive mechanical restraint
Eliminates need for concrete thrust blocks at bends, tees, reducers and end caps
Accommodates angular deflection while maintaining axial restraint
Widest size range in the mechanical joint accessories range — up to DN 900
Suitable for water mains, sewage rising mains and industrial pressure pipelines
High-strength SG iron for long-term performance in buried conditions
Powder or epoxy coating for corrosion protection
options: Coating — Powder / Epoxy (various colours and microns)

image.alt: Retainer Ring (Dn-100 To Dn 900,pn10 /16) – Ductile Iron Pipe Fittings – Socket Bends & Tees

name: Gland For T-type Restrained Joint (Dn-100 To Dn 900,pn10 /16)
summary: A ductile iron gland used in T-type restrained joint assemblies to provide axial restraint and prevent pipe pullout under operating pressure. The T-type configuration works in conjunction with retainer rings and locking segments to grip the pipe spigot positively, forming a fully restrained joint that accommodates angular deflection while resisting axial forces. Essential for pressure pipelines at bends, tees and reducers where thrust block construction is not feasible.
features: T-type configuration provides positive axial restraint against pipe pullout
Works with retainer rings and locking segments for fully restrained joint assembly
Accommodates angular deflection — suitable for uneven ground and directional changes
Eliminates need for concrete thrust blocks at bends, tees and reducers
Widest size range — covers trunk mains and large-diameter pipelines up to DN 900
